# Symphony Crowbar patch

This directory is the maintainer's [Crowbar 0.2.2 release](https://github.com/stedolan/crowbar/tree/v0.2.2).
The MIT license remains in `LICENSE.md`. Crowbar is a test dependency only.

Authenticated opam source archive:

```text
https://github.com/stedolan/crowbar/archive/v0.2.2.tar.gz
sha256: debd1345ac0116232390af64552d15948b5dc7200e287730235f7ff42098f3c5
```

`symphony.patch` changes one upstream line. In `src/crowbar.ml`, the random
source writes `len` bytes beginning at `off` but reports `len - off`. During
partial buffer refill this undercounts generated bytes. A subsequent large
request can repeatedly refill without obtaining the reported capacity.
The fix returns `len`, matching the number written and the file-reader contract.
The public API is unchanged.

`regression/random_refill.{ml,mli}` requests a small random prefix followed by
256 bytes. Before the patch, seed `20260930`, repeat `100` exceeded an external
2-second deadline and was terminated. The same command passed after the patch:

```sh
opam exec --switch=../../ocaml -- dune build regression/random_refill.exe
_build/default/regression/random_refill.exe --seed 20260930 --repeat 100
```

The initial Symphony boundary campaign with that seed and repeat `1000` also
stalled before its first property completed. A native stack sample placed the
work in Crowbar's `getbytes`, `refill`, and random `get_data`, with about 6 MiB
physical footprint. This was a generator defect, not a Symphony parser failure.
The before-patch binary and sample were retained in `/private/tmp` for this
session; the source regression above is the durable reproduction.

Pin `crowbar.0.2.2` to this directory before installing locked test dependencies.
Replay files contain generator entropy; raw YAML/JSON/template corpus files
are not a supported input format for this executable. Curated parser cases
live in the boundary campaign's generators.
